note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Independently bind the row to the exact current official register name and department/canton/Land. Require the unchanged row point inside the own-code municipality boundary, which is used only to check. The literal stored item has settlement-only own P31; the replacement has municipality P31 and exactly the same own official code. Reject targets used by any CSC city, county or state. Unresolved keys additionally require v4.0 municipality or matching national municipal admin-level scope and unchanged name, state, point and item. Only wikiDataId changes.
